title: 第5章 都是野王
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

昨天打韩服排位时候，陈周就知道自己肯定对不了线。

2016年的《英雄联盟》和后世的节奏差别太大了。补刀的平A前摇、技能的判定弹道、伤害数值的隐性计算，全都有着微小的滞后感。

这种滞后感在真金白银局肯定没什么影响，自己依然能在真金白银局里游龙。

但到了王者局开始，它是致命的。

更何况，他现在坐着的是战马电竞椅，在顶级赛场上，坐在他对面的人叫EasyHoon。

EasyHoon固然对线不强，但那得看是和谁比，和Faker比，对方对线不强，但和他比起来，对方就是恐怖的对线机器了。

“好的，双方已经进入召唤师峡谷。”

米勒的声音刚落，导播镜头切到中路。

蓝色方VG，中单瑞兹。

红色方LGD，中单卡牌。

娃娃先“咦”了一声。

“这一把Tree还是拿了卡牌啊……但我说实话，这对线有点难受的，真的不好打。”

“非常不好打。”米勒接得很快，“尤其打的是EasyHoon这种中单。”

他停顿了一下，在组织措辞。

“很多观众会觉得，厉害的中单一定是那种线上疯狂单杀、操作拉满的类型，但侯爷最恐怖的地方其实从来不是单杀。”

屏幕里，瑞兹已经提前一步站进兵线中央。

没有任何多余动作，只是轻轻往前一卡。

卡牌的位置立刻被逼得往后退了半步。

“你会发现，”米勒看着OB镜头，“侯爷对距离的控制特别夸张。他不像有些中单会给你一种压迫感特别强、随时想操作你的感觉。”

“他给人的感觉更像...”

“防御塔。”娃娃忽然插了一句。

“对。”米勒笑了一下，“就是重型防御塔。”

“而且还是韩式运营巅峰时代那种中单。”

“他不会露破绽。”

娃娃补充道：“要我说，对新人来说，侯爷这种中单比Faker这种中单还要更难打，后者有可能会给你操作的机会，前者压根不给你机会，润物细无声就掌管了比赛。”

米勒猛地点头道：“没错，更要命的是，老干爹这边的艾米也是新人，他对位的是丹迪，很难给Tree这名选手起到帮助啊。”

“很难帮他缓解兵线上的压力。”娃娃说。

米勒补充道：“而且面对丹迪，你去帮忙缓解压力，很可能被丹迪带着小段来线上打一波反蹲，那就直接炸穿！”

丹迪，前三星白的打野，也有野王的外号，但此野王可和艾米的野王外号不一样，这是褒义的。

在S4世界赛上，丹迪和Mata的一手野辅联动，给全球职业战队狠狠上了一课。

小段是VG的辅助，这把选的是牛头。

兵线刚接触。

瑞兹立刻开始利用Q技能补尾刀。

每一次平A后摇，都顺手往前压半步。

卡牌只能让线。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yesterday when he was playing ranked in the Korean server, Chen Zhou knew that he would definitely not be able to line up.

The rhythm of "League of Legends" in 2016 is very different from that of later generations.There is a slight sense of lag in the flat A forward swing of the last hit, the trajectory of the skill, and the implicit calculation of the damage value.

This kind of lag will definitely have no impact in the real money and silver game. I can still swim in the real money and silver game.

But when the king's game begins, it is fatal.

What's more, he is currently sitting on a War Horse e-sports chair. In the top arena, the person sitting opposite him is called EasyHoon.

Although EasyHoon is not strong in laning, it depends on who he is competing with. Compared with Faker, the opponent is not strong in laning, but compared with him, the opponent is a terrifying laning machine.

"Okay, both sides have entered Summoner's Canyon."

As soon as Miller's voice fell, the camera cut to the middle.

The blue side VG, mid laner Ryze.

Red side LGD, mid lane card.

The doll said "Hey" first.

"Tree still got the card this time...but to be honest, this lane is a bit uncomfortable and it's really hard to play."

"It's very difficult to play." Miller answered quickly, "Especially against a mid laner like EasyHoon."

He paused, gathering his words.

"Many viewers will think that a powerful mid laner must be the type who has crazy solo kills and full operations online, but the scariest thing about Hou Ye is actually never the solo kill."

On the screen, Ryze had already stepped into the center of the army line one step ahead.

There is no extra movement, just a slight step forward.

The card's position was immediately forced back half a step.

"You will find," Miller looked at the OB camera, "that Mr. Hou's control of distance is particularly exaggerated. Unlike some mid laners, he will give you a feeling of strong pressure and want to control you at any time."

"He feels more like..."

"Defense tower." Wawa suddenly interjected.

"Yes." Miller smiled, "It's a heavy defense tower."

"And he's still the kind of mid laner he was at the peak of Korean operations."

"He won't show any flaws."

Wawa added: "I would say that for newcomers, a mid laner like Hou Ye is more difficult to play than a mid laner like Faker. The latter may give you a chance to operate, but the former will not give you a chance at all, and Runwu will take charge of the game silently."

Miller nodded sharply and said: "Yes, what's more terrible is that Amy on Lao Gan Daddy's side is also a newcomer. He is facing Dandy, so it is difficult to help the player Tree."

"It's difficult to help him relieve the pressure on the military line." Wawa said.

Miller added: "And facing Dandy, if you go to help relieve the pressure, it is very likely that Dandy will bring a small section to the line to do a wave of counter-crouching, and then it will be directly blasted through!"

Dandy, the former jungler of Samsung White, also has the nickname of Wild King, but this Wild King is different from Amy's Wild King nickname, which is a compliment.

In the S4 World Championship, Dandy and Mata's first-hand jungle support teamwork taught professional teams around the world a hard lesson.

Xiao Duan is VG's auxiliary, and this one chooses Bull Head.

The lines of troops have just come into contact.

Ryze immediately began to use the Q skill to replenish the tail knife.

Every time you swing back to flat A, take a half step forward.

Cards can only give way.
